verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm, and its digital offerings (LathamDrive resources, a document generator, a jargon glossary app) are client-facing aids rather than a developer platform. Official SDKs are a category error for this kind of product. No evidence shows it ships any SDK or API, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404, so the exception for a shipped wrong-axis capability does not apply.
